newsitem.title: KUWAIT: U.S. deploys Patriot battery in Kuwait - officials.
newsitem.headline: U.S. deploys Patriot battery in Kuwait - officials.

text.p: The United States has deployed a battery of Patriot air defence missile launchers in Gulf Arab ally Kuwait, U.S. military officials said on Wednesday.
"They arrived earlier this week," one the officials, who declined to be identified, said in brief remarks by telephone.

Another U.S. official, military spokesman Lieutenant Colonel Thomas Nickerson, declined to say when the U.S. battery had arrived but added it had been moved to Kuwait from another location in the Arabian peninsula.
The United States earlier this month sent two Patriot anti-missile batteries and U.S. soldiers to Saudi Arabia in response to the latest tensions with Iraq, a U.S. military official said on Tuesday.
Reporters in Kuwait saw a number of Patriot launchers deployed near a military facility north of Kuwait City but it was not immediately known if they were the newly arrived U.S. units.
Kuwait has taken delivery of some of the Patriot launchers it ordered after the 1991 Gulf War but military analysts say these are not yet fully operational.
